prompt:
Write to the organizer of a neighborhood cleanup explaining that you can help with sorting supplies but cannot stay for the whole event. Aim for about 120 words.

Write the requested response as one self-contained paragraph of plain text. Do not use a title, headings, bullet points, numbered lists, Markdown formatting, code fences, or line breaks. Include only the requested content, without any introductory or closing commentary from the assistant. Keep the approximate word target given in the task. If the task calls for an email, dialogue, steps, or calculations, express that content within the same paragraph.
base_prompt: Write to the organizer of a neighborhood cleanup explaining that you can help with sorting supplies but cannot stay for the whole event. Aim for about 120 words.
text: Dear Organizer, Thank you for coordinating the neighborhood cleanup. I’d be happy to help with sorting and organizing the supplies before the cleanup gets fully underway. I can arrive early to separate gloves, trash bags, safety vests, grabbers, and any other materials into clearly labeled groups so volunteers can find what they need quickly. I can also help check quantities and prepare supply stations for each team. Unfortunately, I have another commitment later that day, so I won’t be able to stay for the entire event. Please let me know what time would be most useful for me to arrive and whether there are any specific sorting tasks you would like me to prioritize. I’m glad I can still contribute to making the cleanup run smoothly. Best, [Your Name]
